description: This file defines the FogBugz API wrapper class, including related classes for HTTP requests and error handling. It contains the main class 'FogBugz' which provides methods for authenticating, sending API requests, and managing connections with a FogBugz server.

classes.name: FogBugz
classes.description: Main class providing an interface to the FogBugz API, handling authentication, requests, and session management.

classes.name: FogBugzCurl
classes.description: A simple cURL wrapper to facilitate HTTP requests to the FogBugz API, including configuration and response handling.

classes.name: FogBugzCurlError
classes.description: Exception class for errors encountered during cURL requests.

classes.name: FogBugzAPIError
classes.description: General exception class for FogBugz API-related errors.

classes.name: FogBugzLogonError
classes.description: Specialized exception indicating errors during login attempts, subclass of FogBugzAPIError.

classes.name: FogBugzConnectionError
classes.description: Exception class for connection-specific errors, subclass of FogBugzAPIError.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new FogBugz object with optional credentials and server details, setting up the cURL handler.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up the object, logging off if a token is present.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Intercepts calls to undefined methods, dynamically routing them as API commands.

methods.name: logon
methods.description: Performs login to FogBugz, retrieves and stores an authentication token.

methods.name: logoff
methods.description: Logs out from FogBugz, invalidating the stored token.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Internal method for sending API requests to FogBugz, handling URL construction, token management, and response parsing.
